provenance.description: Offline synthetic public contract vectors. The RSA key was generated independently in memory solely to sign these fixed bytes; no private key was serialized or retained.
provenance.enrollmentPublicEvidence: Copied byte-for-byte from the independently signed shared proof-profile fixture guarded by its SHA-256.
provenance.requestProofSignatures: Canonical shape-only synthetic bytes; Ed25519 verification is deliberately not evaluated by this PR.
